name: Northern Mariana Islands
prevalence_note: No Commonwealth-level scam bulletin was found; US postal inspectors' warnings on fake tracking texts and impersonation calls apply to mail routed to Saipan, Tinian and Rota.
cross_border_note: The Northern Marianas (+1-670) use NANP numbering, and long mainland transit gives delivery-confirmation calls a plausible cover.

scams.name: Fake USPS delivery-confirmation call
scams.name_en: Call or text asking a Northern Marianas resident to confirm a USPS delivery

red_flag_keywords.text: confirm your full address and card

scams.signals_en: An automated call or text says a USPS delivery to Saipan needs confirmation and asks for address and payment data.
scams.legit_en: USPIS states USPS does not call or text asking for personal data unless the customer requested tracking updates.
bait_tactics: Ask which Saipan post office will hand it over
Say Ground parcels from the mainland always arrive late and no one calls about them
